files.name: DigToTarget.java

help: After collect STUCK: hand-mine the nearest remembered target block, tunnelling straight toward it by keys
lesson: Collect STUCK repeats right after unstuck/goto failures because the same pathfinder stalls; going straight at a remembered block with keys and hand-mining bypasses the route that keeps stalling.
summary: dig_to_target: right after collect fails STUCK, mines the nearest remembered target block by hand, digging a 1x2 key-driven tunnel toward it instead of re-pathing with Baritone
